}}{{TIDTOC|embedded}} ==Overview== ZLT X300 is a highly advanced 5G indoor multi-service product solution specifically designed to meet integrated data, and 802.11a/b/g/n/ac/ax/be Tri-bands Wi-Fi access needs for residential, business and enterprise users. The product supports advanced Gigabit networking and Tri-bands Wi-Fi AP functionalities. It supports built-in high-gain 5G omnidirectional/directional antennas, and adopts a smart antenna switching algorithm to switch the corresponding high-gain directional antennas intelligently according to the direction of the base station.It enables wide service coverage and provides high data throughput and networking features to customers who needs easy broadband access, hot-spot Wi-Fi connectivity.
